**Meridian Tidal Pilot - Summary**

The only significant failure was Turbine T-4, which went offline on 14 March 2025 after a bearing seal corroded through, allowing seawater into the nacelle; the root cause was traced to corrosion of the bearing seal housing. The pilot delivered 18.7 GWh over 24 months—6% below the original forecast of 19.9 GWh. The project finished at EUR 41.25M against an approved budget of EUR 36.7M, a EUR 4.55M overrun (12.4%) driven mainly by the T-4 repair campaign. An independent fish-monitoring programme found no statistically significant change in fish migration counts post-installation. Lead engineer Dr. Ines Marchetti recommended replacing the titanium fastener set with duplex stainless steel on all remaining nacelles—an option the steering group accepted in principle. Steering group approval for Phase 2 has been granted for the third quarter of 2026, contingent on a completed bearing seal redesign and a successful dry-dock endurance test.
